meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把任意文字内容变成生动的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把文章或笔记快速变成讲解视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into an engaging explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos quickly

howto.what: 给 Claude 一段文章、笔记或主题，它会做成“无脸”解说视频：画面全靠排版、图形、图表和数据图。它先写脚本和分镜，再配旁白和音乐，最后渲染成 mp4 文件。
howto.when: 当你说“把这段文字做成解说视频”，或要求进行主题解说、概念拆解、教程等时触发；但产品宣发类视频不归它管，不确定时会交给 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成无脸解说视频，重点讲清复利概念。
say.note: Claude 会生成分镜脚本并渲染成片。

say.text: 用这段笔记生成教程视频的旁白和分镜。
say.note: 它会先规划教学故事，再产出音频。

say.text: 把这份提纲做成列表式解说视频，配上旁白和音乐。
say.note: 过程中会经过审批检查点。

howto.what_en: Give Claude an article, notes, or a topic, and it turns it into a 'faceless' explainer video: no real footage, visuals are invented (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, charts). It writes a script and storyboard, generates narration and music, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to turn a piece of text into an explainer video for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, or how-tos. Not for product-promo videos; if unsure, it defers to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video, focusing on compound interest.
say_en.note: Claude will generate storyboard and script, then render the video.

say_en.text: Use these notes to create a tutorial video's narration and storyboard.
say_en.note: It plans the teaching story first, then produces audio.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a list-style explainer with narration and music.
